subject: general
question: The cultivation of ___________ was introduced on the Baba Budan Hills in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**coffee**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Coffee:-**

 
 
• The coffee harvesting season typically occurs between November and February.
 
• Coffee is often grown in shade, either within natural forest areas or under a mix of shade trees on plantations.
 
• This practice helps protect the coffee plants from harsh sunlight and provides a conducive microclimate. Coffee plants require well-drained soil and moderate rainfall.
 
• Baba Budan hill'), also known as Chandradrona ( lit. 'Moon guide', as the range naturally forms the shape of a crescent moon), is a hill and mountain range in the Western Ghats of India, located in the Chikkamagaluru district of Karnataka. 
 
• **The cultivation of coffee was introduced on the Baba Budan Hills in India.**

 **​**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Tea cultivation in India was introduced in the region of** Assam**. 
 
• The cultivation of silk in India is believed to have been introduced in the region of ancient India known as Kanchipuram, located in present-day Tamil Nadu. 
 
• The cultivation of cardamom in India is believed to have been introduced in the southern state of Kerala.
